types.name: invalid_credentials
types.meaning: Wrong email or password.

types.name: totp_required
types.meaning: A second factor is needed.

types.name: invalid_code
types.meaning: Wrong TOTP or recovery code.

types.name: reenrol_required
types.meaning: Signed in with a recovery code; the second factor must be re-enrolled.

types.name: throttled
types.meaning: Too many attempts. Carries retryAfter.

types.name: identity_not_linked
types.meaning: The D3 Auth identity is not linked to an account here.

types.name: refresh_reused
types.meaning: A rotated refresh token was replayed; the session is revoked.

types.name: session_revoked
types.meaning: The session was revoked server-side.

types.name: step_up_required
types.meaning: A fresh step-up is needed. Carries maxAgeSeconds.

types.name: capability_missing
types.meaning: This server lacks the capability.

types.name: last_owner
types.meaning: The last owner cannot delete themselves.

types.name: forbidden_role
types.meaning: The account's role does not permit this.

types.name: invite_invalid
types.meaning: The invite token was used, revoked or expired.
types.client: Explain; ask for a new invite.

types.name: weak_password
types.meaning: The new password does not meet the product's policy; detail says how.

types.name: last_factor
types.meaning: Removing this would leave an admin or owner with no second factor.
types.client: Explain that one passkey or authenticator must stay.

types.name: owner_protected
types.meaning: The owner cannot be suspended, demoted or removed by someone else.

types.name: not_yourself
types.meaning: That action cannot be taken on your own account.

types.name: taken
types.meaning: That username or address is already in use.

types.name: already_a_user
types.meaning: Someone with that address already has an account.
types.client: Inline field error on the invite form.

types.name: already_exists
types.meaning: Something with that name or id is already registered.
